insight: Uses AI trained on millions of anonymized clinical records to surface probable diagnoses, but a human clinician reviews each case.
name: K Health
tagline: AI-assisted virtual primary care, with a clinician reviewing every case.
description: K Health combines an AI symptom intake — built on anonymized clinical records — with virtual visits from licensed clinicians for primary and mental-health care. The AI surfaces probable diagnoses and pathways, but a clinician reviews each case and makes clinical decisions. It operates on direct-pay subscriptions and per-visit pricing.
